headline: War Day 515: Six Fronts Escalate Amid Soaring Losses
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the conflict still pivots on six hot corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, logging 56 ownership changes in the past day; the latest hour shows Colonial and Warden casualties climbing past 1,000 per hour each, with both two‑hour trends accelerating sharply. Callahans Passage continues to bleed — 1,392 Colonial and 1,599 Warden losses in the last two hours — and its one‑hour rates have surged to 833 and 1,095 respectively, both accelerating. Palantine Berm has intensified, recording 272 Colonial and 364 Warden casualties in two hours; one‑hour rates now exceed 180 and 260 per hour, also accelerating. Stlican Shelf shows a mixed picture: Colonial losses have cooled to 50 per hour while Warden losses rise to 68, the two‑hour trend still climbing for both sides. Nevish Line’s Colonial rate has jumped to 166 per hour (accelerating) while Warden losses ease to 154 (cooling). Stonecradle’s casualties have fallen to single digits per hour, yet the two‑hour trend shows a modest rise for both factions. Enlistment activity mirrors the fighting, climbing on the most active fronts and remaining flat elsewhere. New low‑level skirmishes appear in Callums Cape, Kuura Strand, Mooring County and Oarbreaker, but none have generated significant base turnover.
